description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to auto-translation and translation management within the Mattermost project, including translation states, types, and context handling for auto-translation paths.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Translation object, copying all fields including nested maps and JSON data.

methods.name: ToPostTranslation
methods.description: Converts a Translation object into a PostTranslation object, extracting source language and content based on translation type.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Translation object, ensuring required fields are set and consistent with the translation state.

methods.name: Error (ErrAutoTranslationNotAvailable)
methods.description: Represents an error indicating auto-translation feature is unavailable due to licensing, configuration, or feature flag issues.

methods.name: WithAutoTranslationPath
methods.description: Adds an auto-translation path to the context for observability and behavior control.

methods.name: GetAutoTranslationPath
methods.description: Retrieves the auto-translation path from the context, defaulting to 'unknown' if not set.
